meta.status_note: PLANNING DRAFT. Regions marked built-elsewhere (the Treasure Island training city, the four Louisiana parish cities, the Bay Area hill districts) are 3D city artifacts built in other AGI Future Foundation projects; they are not in this repository and are not verified by it. Every figure quoted for them (building and parcel counts, relay capacity) is that project's, unchecked here. "in progress" and "planned" mean what they say.
meta.product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy, powered by AGI Corp

env_details.site: Orleans Parish heritage plaster and ironwork shop (built site, heritage trades phase)
env_details.surfaces: lime plaster over brick lath, cypress floorboards, wrought-iron balcony stock, slate roofing samples; procedural PBR from the 23-surface set with heritage finish kit
env_details.props: plaster hawks and trowels, forge and anvil, scaffold tower, moldings in progress, salvage bins
env_details.hazards: lead paint dust on removal, scaffold fall exposure, forge burns, silica from brick cutting
env_details.lighting: warm window daylight through shutters, tungsten work lights, humid haze; night mode with lantern-tone fixtures

env_details.site: St. Bernard Parish levee and floodgate
env_details.surfaces: compacted clay levee crown, riprap, concrete floodwall panels, rusted steel floodgate, wet grass
env_details.props: floodgate hydraulic unit, sandbag pallets, survey stakes, inspection drone pad (planned cell), pump station access hatch
env_details.hazards: slope slip in rain, drowning risk at water edge, pinch points on gate hinges, lightning during storms
env_details.lighting: flat overcast Gulf light, storm darkening with lightning flashes, sodium security lights at night

env_details.site: Treasure Island union hall and driving yard (built)
env_details.surfaces: polished concrete hall floor, asphalt yard with painted lanes, chain-link perimeter, steel-frame hall with brick base
env_details.props: classroom benches, tool cribs, cones and lane markers, forklifts, telehandler, excavator, exoskeleton fitting station (planned)
env_details.hazards: struck-by in yard lanes, backing blind spots, load drop, wind gusts off the bay
env_details.lighting: bay daylight with fog-softened shadows, LED high-bays indoors, yard floodlights at night with Bay Bridge backdrop

env_details.site: Data center build (built site, data center phase)
env_details.surfaces: raised access floor tiles, epoxy slab, painted CMU, cable tray steel, white hot/cold aisle containment panels
env_details.props: server racks, PDUs, CRAH units, cable pulls on reels, lift carts, rack robot arm (planned cell)
env_details.hazards: arc flash at PDUs, floor tile openings, heavy rack tip-over, noise
env_details.lighting: cool-white LED linear fixtures, status LED glow, emergency lighting test mode

env_details.site: Lake Charles LNG terminal pipe rack (planned)
env_details.surfaces: galvanized grating, insulated pipe jacketing, painted structural steel, gravel pad, frost on cryogenic lines
env_details.props: pipe spools, flange kits, chain hoists, gas monitors, confined-space tripod, permit board
env_details.hazards: cryogenic burns, flammable atmosphere, confined space, work at height, heat stress
env_details.lighting: harsh Gulf sun with heat shimmer, flare glow at night, explosion-proof fixtures

env_details.site: Nob Hill steep-grade trench (scenario on built terrain)
env_details.surfaces: continuous-terrain asphalt at real grade, Victorian painted facades, concrete curbs, exposed soil and shoring
env_details.props: trench box, hydraulic shoring, mini excavator, traffic control signs, utility locate flags
env_details.hazards: trench collapse, equipment rollover on grade, struck-by traffic, buried utility strike
env_details.lighting: low-angle SF afternoon sun, rolling fog bank, streetlights and cable car glow at dusk
